name: Tao people (Orchid Island, Taiwan)
description: A white field with decorative black-and-red geometric bands along the top and bottom edges. At the centre is the mata no tatala (boat-eye) emblem in black, red and white, flanked by two black human figures.
history: Flag of the Tao (Yami), the Austronesian people of Orchid Island (Lanyu); the boat-eye and the dancer figures come from the decoration of the traditional tatala canoe.

features.role: geometric bands along the top and bottom edges
